title: Zincronized NiCo selenides coupled with polypyrrole: a synergistic route to high-energy asymmetric supercapacitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35573-35585
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04328J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Anique Ahmed, Muhammad Ramzan Abdul Karim, Muhammad Usman
In this work, a Zn-doped NiCoSe2/PPy composite was developed with enhanced redox activity, conductivity, and stability whose ASC device delivered 130.7 Wh kg−1 energy density, 11 900 W kg−1 power density, and 94.3% capacity retention after 5000 cycles.
